notes.title: Expand your little garden with NEW ROOMS!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822171/0a332395686e772d746ea752df3518723a1572f0.png[/img]

I have read your comments, reviews, suggestions, and most of you want more space for your plant collections! 

So I added a new feature! NEW ROOMS are now available in the game! You can now buy a new empty room to decorate or to use as a storage for your items!

Please update your game to v1.2.0! Your progress or save files won't be affected.


To buy you a new room, head over to the Magic Orbs and Upgrades tab in the shop!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822171/44b0a59d6ddacd6fed9977d796f5a773fa1322af.png[/img]

To change to a new room, a new button has been added to the upper right corner of your screen! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822171/56f4c551f91e3a2961bbd406ed00b1c44c293d2a.png[/img]

Golds and plants are on pause on the other room so you don't have to worry about them dying!



Thank you so much for playing the game! 
- Adee

If you encounter any bugs or errors, feel free to share them here!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2764070/discussions/0/4202490864583449386/

notes.title: Plantabi: Little Garden is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822171/0a332395686e772d746ea752df3518723a1572f0.png[/img]

TODAY is officially the day! You can now dive into the world of "Plantabi: Little Garden" on Steam and create your very own cozy indoor garden.

Plantabi is a chill and relaxing game where you nurture plants and help the shop owner to unlock more plants and items!

Grab it now at a 20% discount for its release week!

And hey, if you enjoy the game, why not drop a review or share it with your fellow plant enthusiasts? Every bit of support means the world!

Encountering any bugs or issues? Feel free to post them here so I can swiftly address them: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2764070/discussions/0/4202490864583449386/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2764070/discussions/0/4202490864583449386/[/url]

Also, if you're content creators and you'd like to receive a code, hit me up through my socials and contacts listed on my webpage!

Thanks a lot for your support! :)
- Adee
